descrizione:
How did Roman soldiers sleep just two miles from an army of 40,000 enemies without fear? The answer wasn't a stone fortress or a castle on a hill. It was a hole in the ground, dug by hand by exhausted men in a couple of hours.

In this video we explore the strangest habit of the Roman army: the marching camp. Built every single night, it protected the legions for 600 years and helped make Rome unstoppable.

Watch to discover how Roman engineering, discipline and routine turned a simple ditch into the safest bed in the ancient world.
